styles.name: Enchanted Realms
styles.subtitle: Highly detailed fantasy
styles.description: Rich painterly fantasy artwork: emerald and teal foliage, warm amber key light from the upper left, crisp silhouettes and detailed texture.

styles.name: Moonlit Reverie
styles.subtitle: Nocturnal fantasy
styles.description: The same painting technique art-directed for night: cool silver-blue key light, deep indigo shadows and reduced saturation. Every asset in this collection is graded identically so the scene stays coherent.

styles.name: Harvest Season
styles.subtitle: Autumnal fantasy
styles.description: The same painterly technique art-directed for autumn: foliage shifted to amber, copper and rust while stone, bark and water keep their natural colour, under the same warm upper-left key light.

styles.name: Clearwater
styles.subtitle: Ultra-realistic
styles.description: Photographic realism rather than painted fantasy: true water optics with refraction, caustics on the bed and specular sparkle on the surface. Painted from its own plates. Ships no room interiors - a photoreal room needs photographing, not recolouring.

styles.name: Frostfall
styles.subtitle: Painted winter
styles.description: An independently painted winter collection, not a recolouring: snow-laden conifers, frosted bare branches, ice and low cold light. Outdoor artwork is painted from its own plates; interiors are shared with the Enchanted look because a room has no season.
